messages:
Alex Chen: starting swing pass — quick creds + coverage scrub before I log off in 20. primary is me until 22:00 UTC, Jamie will take nights (primary at 22:00 UTC). Samir is secondary for the midnight -> 08:00 UTC stretch.
Alex Chen: current open incident (INC-4582) is active but mitigated, page noise should be minimal. leaving notes in the incident channel. @ops-bot please post runbook link. :white_check_mark:
ops-bot: Runbook link: https://redwood.runbooks/incidents/redis-throttle. Steps 1-4 for mitigation + rollback are pinned.
Jamie Ortiz: noted. quick permissions check — I still don't have grafana team view for the prod org (404 when opening dashboards). anyone else seeing that?
Samir Patel: I can open them. Jamie, what URL are you hitting?
Jamie Ortiz: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/pK9kz/prod-summary?orgId=43 — hitting 403 earlier, now it shows org but panels time out.
Priya Kapoor: FYI we have a coverage gap in APAC for 02:00-04:00 UTC this week (vacation). If any high-risk deploy windows happen then we need a fallback anchor.
Alex Chen: noted Priya. For the pass-off checklist: 1) verify PagerDuty escalation access 2) verify AWS assume-role for oncall 3) verify Grafana view + alert mute privileges 4) confirm runbook pinned + incident links 5) confirm Slack bridge access.
Alex Chen: PagerDuty quick check: go to https://pagerduty.com/teams/redwood-inference -> Teams -> Oncall -> check you see "Primary on rotation" and can trigger a test page.
Jamie Ortiz: I ran a PD test, it reached me but the UI didn't show me as on-call (still shows Alex). Samir, can you confirm rotation state?
Samir Patel: rotation shows Jamie as next in 40m. PD caches the UI, but the scheduling engine has next start at 22:00 UTC. test pages still route to Alex until then.
Alex Chen: AWS: assume-role snippet below — if you can't assume, you'll get AccessDenied. run this in your workstation terminal before starting on-call duties:
```
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/Redwood-Oncall --role-session-name oncall-session --duration-seconds 3600
```
Alex Chen: if assume fails, check you have SSO permission set 'OncallAccess' and that your identity provider mapped the role. Samir, we recently rotated that role key last week — double-check the role trust policy if people see failures.
Samir Patel: role trust is good. I just added Jamie's new SSO mapping at 10:12 UTC. Jamie, logout/login to SSO and try again.
Jamie Ortiz: re-authed, assume-role returns creds now. thanks. Grafana still flaky though.
ops-bot: ALERT: There is an active alert: prod-redis-high-latency (firing) — linked incident INC-4582.
Alex Chen: acknowledging. For Grafana perms: team name is "oncall-ops" and folder permissions are set at team level. If you get 403, we usually add you via admin -> teams -> add member. Samir, can you add Jamie to oncall-ops with Viewer+Mute?
Samir Patel: done. granted Viewer and Alert Mute. confirm?
Jamie Ortiz: can view dashboards now and can mute alert. good.
Priya Kapoor: PagerDuty escalation policies — check that secondary has the "escalate to manager" override disabled for the first 30m. We had a noisy escalation churn last month.
Alex Chen: policy name: "Oncall-Core-Escalation". Samir, can you confirm the reorder suppression is live for this rotation?
Samir Patel: suppression window set to 30m. also enabled fast-failback to fallback-group in eu-west-1 if primary doesn't ack in 10m.
Jamie Ortiz: one more check — Slack bridge: sometimes ops-runbook-bot loses webhook perms and can't update incident threads. I couldn't post to INC-4582 earlier.
Alex Chen: steps if webhook fails: 1) check Slack app tokens at https://api.redwood.com/integrations/slack/apps/ops-runbook 2) hit /apps/test-webhook 3) reauthorize app in workspace if 401.
Priya Kapoor: adding a short doc note: when handing off after an active incident, run the incident sanity checklist (in runbook) and `@pagerduty test` to ensure PD routing. Also leave a 3-line TL;DR in the incident thread: what changed, what to watch for, next steps.
Alex Chen: I'm going to leave the TL;DR now: "Redis latency spike mitigated by scaled read replicas, monitoring for recurrence, PD escalation suppressed for 30m, next primary Jamie at 22:00 UTC, Samir secondary from 00:00 UTC. Grafana and AWS creds validated for new primaries."
Jamie Ortiz: got it. I'll take over at 22:00 UTC. Samir, can you be on the bridge for the first 30 minutes of my shift?
Samir Patel: yes, I'll be on the bridge 22:00-22:30 UTC.
Alex Chen: thanks all — logging off now. If anything urgent ping PD and @samir directly. :wave:
